color.note: Seven brand colors (fixed in every theme), then the semantic roles components use. Build with the roles; reach for a brand color by name only for illustration, print and swag.

tokens.name: river-trench
tokens.usage: Brand color. Primary text, deep dark backgrounds, dark-mode surfaces, and the label on every Kelp Amber fill (6.6:1).

tokens.name: stream-blue
tokens.usage: Brand color. Primary brand accent: links, active states, filters, tabs, key secondary CTAs. 4.8:1 on Pebble Cream, 5.2:1 under white text. Too dark for text on River Trench (3.3:1): dark mode uses accent instead.

tokens.name: pebble-cream
tokens.usage: Brand color. Warm canvas background (replaces sterile #FFFFFF); text color on River Trench.

tokens.name: kelp-amber
tokens.usage: Brand color. Primary pop: OtterGo and checkout buttons, notification pings. A fill only, always labeled in River Trench. Never text on light grounds: 2.5:1 on Pebble Cream fails, as does a bare amber dot (keep it beside a number or word).

tokens.name: otter-belly
tokens.usage: Brand color. Secondary borders, neutral container fills, chip backgrounds. Decorative only as a border (1.4:1): never the sole outline of a control.

tokens.name: moss-green
tokens.usage: Brand color. Success badges, confirmed check-ins, early-bird status. 6.0:1 on Pebble Cream; white text on it 6.4:1.

tokens.name: driftwood
tokens.usage: Brand color. Muted secondary copy, mascot line art, warm dividers. 7.1:1 on Pebble Cream, 5.4:1 on Otter Belly.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tickets, drawers and the search pebble, always with a stroke-card border in border. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: surface-fill
tokens.usage: Neutral container fills: chips, avatar discs, image slots, the Raft Mode track. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The soft card border (stroke-card, 1.5px) and warm hairlines. Decorative: pair with a shadow or a fill change, never alone around a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines that carry meaning: inputs, the search pebble, quiet buttons, unchecked toggles. 3.4:1 or better on surface and surface-card in both themes. Derived from Driftwood.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-card, surface-fill, accent-soft, action-soft and success-soft (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, metadata, host lines and timestamps on surface, surface-card and surface-fill (5.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active tab and filter, selected states, secondary buttons; as text on surface, surface-card and accent-soft (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Dark value is a lightened Stream Blue.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: selected chips, the active Raft Mode segment's halo, the search ripple's resting tint.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (5.2:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one high-conversion action per view: OtterGo, checkout, Grab a Paw. Also notification pings (always beside a number). The fill is only 2.5:1 against light grounds (kept exact as the brand's color), so the River Trench label and shadow-pebble's stone edge carry the button's boundary; never use it as an outline or text.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill (6.6:1). Never white.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint behind ink text: scarcity badges ("8 seats left"), the NEW tag in the announcement pill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, checked in, early bird; as text or icon on surface, surface-card and success-soft (5.4:1 or better in both themes). Always with a word or check icon. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text: confirmation banners, early-bird badges.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a success fill (6.4:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: wave-line
tokens.usage: Current Flow wave dividers and the kelp mooring line: decorative 1px strokes at low opacity.

tokens.name: ripple
tokens.usage: River Ripple rings that expand behind the search pebble on focus. Decorative.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Tint for drop-shadow filters on cut-out shapes (ticket stubs), where a box-shadow cannot follow the notches.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the Pebble Pouch drawer and dialogs.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces with the SOFT axis at 100: the warm soft-serif for heroes and pull quotes. Marketing surfaces only, never inside product UI.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one hero headline per page (ottermeet.io hero is 64px, as specified).

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Keep your group in the raft.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: Expressive pull quotes and editorial callouts.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Plus Jakarta Sans SemiBold and Bold for every product header, label and button.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, segmented controls, agenda item titles.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Pebble badges and tags, in the case written (Title Case for categories, sentence case for status).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Date and place lines above titles, always set in capitals; badge text.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter Regular and Medium for tickets, tables, agendas and running text. Turn on tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for prices, counts and run-times.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Discover workshops, book inspiring offsite venues, and keep your group in the raft.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We paddled upstream, but found nothing here.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card host lines, helper text, list rows.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Ticket fields, table cells, agenda run-times (tabular figures).

spacing.note: 4px base. Cards pad space-5; sections breathe space-16.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; avatar overlap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutters between cards; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and ticket padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Drawer and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between card rows in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page bands, around wave dividers.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on ottermeet.io.

radius.note: Nothing is sharp. Pebbles are fully round or organically uneven; cards are soft.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Image corners inside cards, checkboxes, small tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs inside forms, list rows, timeline time-blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Event cards, tickets, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Drawers, hero panels, large empty-state frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: River Pebble pills: buttons, badges, the search pebble, avatars, segmented controls.

tokens.name: pebble-tl
tokens.usage: Organic pebble shape, top-left corner. Always used as the set: pebble-tl pebble-tr pebble-br pebble-bl (24 20 28 18).

tokens.name: pebble-tr
tokens.usage: Organic pebble shape, top-right corner.

tokens.name: pebble-br
tokens.usage: Organic pebble shape, bottom-right corner.

tokens.name: pebble-bl
tokens.usage: Organic pebble shape, bottom-left corner. The set shapes keepsake badges, ticket stubs and the Pebble Pouch items.

stroke.note: Line weights. Never pure digital black: strokes take ink, border or driftwood.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Wave dividers and the kelp mooring line.

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: The soft border around cards, tickets and the search pebble.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Icon strokes at 24px and outlines on quiet buttons.

tokens.name: stroke-line-art
tokens.usage: Mascot line art and the cover's ripple rules (2.5–3px rounded monoline, in driftwood).

shadow.note: Pebbles rest on a stone edge and sink when pressed; floating tickets cast a soft long shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tickets at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-pebble
tokens.usage: Tactile buttons and the search pebble at rest: a smooth river stone sitting on its edge.

tokens.name: shadow-pebble-pressed
tokens.usage: A pebble while pressed (with translateY 2px).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Stacked hero tickets, the Pebble Pouch drawer, popovers.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on everything: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid accent (4.8:1 light, 6.7:1 dark). Box-shadow, so it follows pebble radii.
